source: mixed-source research dataset: external historical supplement + MT5 broker history
symbol: XAUUSDc (hybrid research series; external section is spot XAUUSD, not broker XAUUSDc)
notes: Rates and spread are broker-terminal historical data; completeness depends on broker/server history limits.
Bar spread is used as a historical cost proxy; it is not tick-by-tick bid/ask replay.
This importer only reads symbol metadata and rates; it does not read account credentials or send orders.

supplement.provider: EV Trading Labs historical OHLCV catalogue; underlying described by provider as aggregated from Dukascopy bid/ask
supplement.spread_estimation: ask-open minus bid-open divided by broker point size; not MT5 XAUUSDc spread
supplement.price_feed_warning: External XAUUSD spot candles are not the same instrument/feed as broker XAUUSDc. The combined file is suitable for exploratory research only and must not be represented as five years of broker-native history.

time_delta_minutes.note: Large gaps include normal weekends/market closures; endpoint date coverage does not prove every expected trading bar exists.
